usedFor: SuperPhone holds text contacts and chats, and MSG91 opens a ticket through “Send Mail via Hello”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact” in SuperPhone, then “Send Mail via Hello” in MSG91
bestTemplate.why: A new contact gets a ticket opened for them, so support has the thread from the start.

watchOut: “Send Mail via Hello” either creates a ticket or replies with a ticket ID, so set which one you want.
